newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel to open six new int'l perishable centres.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel to open six new int'l perishable centres.

text.p: International freight forwarder Kuehne & Nagel International AG said it is expand its perishable goods services to target a growing market.
Newly-appointed perishable goods manager Gerald Kurz said the forwarder would add six new facilities to its existing 36 stations around the world.
"Business is booming and so we are planning the rapid opening of further stations for perishables transport," he said in a company statement.

At the beginning of May, Kuehne & Nagel opened a new perishables centre at Cape Town airport. Now further stations were planned in Arusha (Tanzania), Lilongwe (Malawi), London, Lusaka, Kampala and Tokyo.
The forwarder regularly chartered all-freight aircraft to ensure the on-time arrival of large volume shipments, Kurz noted.
Its Kenya subsidiary alone organised the transport of more than 10,000 tonnes of perishable goods, mostly flowers and fruit, to Europe from September 1996 to May 1997.
Kuehne & Nagel also offered door-door services and additional special services, Kurz added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
